title: adapter_upgrade tests no longer share a scratch folder on Windows
goal: manager_without() named its scratch folder by process id and the clock in nanoseconds. Windows' clock is coarse, so two tests in one process drew the same name; one removed the folder while the other wrote its adapter override ('The system cannot find the path specified'). The name now also carries a per-process counter. Test code only.
validation: On x86_64-pc-windows-msvc: before, the group failed 1 run in 6 and once in the full v0.21.62 test gate; after, 25 runs in a row pass (5 tests each); clippy -p susi-gawd-agents --all-targets -D warnings clean.
